Custom Paper Shopping Bags for Retail Brands: A Sourcing Guide

Published August 21, 2026 · Buyer guide · By BestPackFactory

Quick answer

Specify paper shopping bags by finished size, side and bottom gusset, basis weight (gsm), handle type and maximum load. Confirm the print area, ink coverage, lamination and packing method. Request a sample with the planned contents before approving mass production, because handle attachment and gusset depth determine real load capacity.

Match the bag to the load and channel

A boutique bag for a single garment and a grocery bag for heavy purchases need different paper weights and gusset depths. Define the heaviest typical load, the product dimensions and whether the bag is carried by hand or sits in a car boot. The gusset depth and handle attachment method determine how the load is distributed.

Checklist before quoting

Give the finished width, height and depth, side and bottom gusset, paper gsm and color, handle type, print colors, lamination, quantity tiers and destination. Ask for the recommended packing count per carton and carton dimensions so freight can be compared between suppliers.

Validate with a loaded sample

A bag can look correct and still tear at the handle or open at the gusset under load. Test the real product, a realistic load weight and repeated handling. Check print rub resistance on the lamination and handle attachment strength. Approve the sample before the bulk run.

  1. Define heaviest real load
  2. Confirm size and both gussets

Frequently asked questions

What paper weight do retail paper bags need?

Common retail shopping bags use 80–160 gsm paper; heavier loads and larger bags generally need higher gsm and stronger handles.

Do handles change the bag price?

Yes. Rope, ribbon and die-cut handles have different material and labor costs, so compare the complete specification rather than paper alone.

Can I match my brand color on kraft paper?

Yes, with coated or full-coverage print, but final color should be approved on a physical sample because kraft shows through less with heavier ink coverage.
